note_en: 新歌一上线，后援会就会号召大家反复播放 uses 一…就… "as soon as... (then)...": 一 goes before the first verb and 就 before the second, both after their subjects. Also notice 行程排得满满的 "the schedule is packed full": 得 after a verb introduces how or to what degree the action turns out, where English would use an adverb or a separate adjective.
